subject: Vendor intake: PO field mapping, issuance lead time and billing routing
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: sam.patel@brightworks.io
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor intake: PO field mapping, issuance lead time and billing routing

Sam —

Thanks for taking the call earlier. We want to get your vendor profile and PO flow set up so Finance can issue the first purchase order without back-and-forth. To make sure the PO we issue matches your billing system, can you confirm the following by EOD Thursday?

- Legal entity name exactly as you want it on the PO
- Billing address (street, city, state, ZIP) + preferred invoice email
- Tax ID / VAT ID (if applicable)
- Do you require PO number on invoice line items or just on the header?
- Preferred invoice frequency (net 30 / net 45 / consolidated monthly)
- Line-item schema: do you require description, SKU/service code, unit type (hour/month/license), quantity, unit price, start/end date, account code or cost center fields? If you have a sample PO we can follow, attach it.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fill & return) and sample_purchase_order_schema.xlsx (our proposed mapping).

Proposed timelines:
- 2027-06-01: final vendor form + W-9 (or equivalent) due from BrightWorks
- 2027-06-08: Finance issues first PO (if all info received)

If any of the fields above are a blocker for you, call me and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Senior Program Manager, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (2 pages)]
[Attachment: sample_purchase_order_schema.xlsx (workbook)]
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@brightworks.io>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: emily.chen@brightworks.io
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:14:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: PO field mapping, issuance lead time and billing routing

Hi Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers below, and I’ve attached our completed vendor form and W-9.

- Legal entity: BrightWorks, Inc. (please include the comma)
- Billing address: 410 Market St, Suite 210, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Invoice contact: billing@brightworks.io (Emily Chen)
- Tax ID: 94-1234567 (W-9 attached)
- PO placement: We prefer PO number on header and on invoice line items where available.
- Invoice frequency: Consolidated monthly invoices are preferred; net 30 payment terms.
- Line-item schema: We can accept the fields you proposed. Our internal cost center mapping uses a 6-digit account code — we’ll provide a small mapping file. For services billed hourly, please include hours, rate and total per line. For platform credits, SKU and quantity suffice.

I’ve attached: signed_vendor_form_filled.pdf and w9_brightworks.pdf. I’m looping Emily (billing) to confirm any follow-ups.

If Finance needs a prereq — e.g., vendor portal registration — tell us and we’ll get it completed this week.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Procurement
BrightWorks, Inc.
[Attachment: signed_vendor_form_filled.pdf]
[Attachment: w9_brightworks.pdf]

Thanks Sam — that’s very helpful. Confirming receipt of the W-9 and completed form. A couple follow-ups and next steps:

1) PO line-item mapping — attached is mapping_po_vs_finance.xlsx that maps our standard PO columns to your preferred fields. Key asks: include either an account_code (6 digits) or cost_center on every line. Finance uses that for GL mapping.

2) Sample PO — I attached sample_po_preview.pdf showing the header + two example lines (services and platform credits). Can you confirm: a) the header layout works for your AP system, and b) the service line contains enough detail (hours/rate) for your auditors?

3) Timeline update — Finance can issue the PO on 2027-06-08 if we have the vendor form and W-9 by 2027-06-01. Dev, will you confirm the issuance date below so BrightWorks can plan invoice submission?

4) Routing — Please direct invoices to billing@brightworks.io and copy finance-payments@redwood.ai when you send the first invoice. We’ll validate remittance details on receipt.

If everything above is green, I’ll move the HubSpot supplier record to “Ready for PO” and send the procurement ticket to Finance (SUP-4298).

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Senior Program Manager, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
